newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZOG awarded offshore permit west of Maui.
newsitem.headline: NZOG awarded offshore permit west of Maui.

text.p: New Zealand Oil & Gas Ltd said on Tuesday it had been granted a permit to explore for oil over a 5,500 square kilometre area west of the Maui oil and gas field offshore from the west coast of the North Island.

NZOG said the potential of this area was highlighted by the discovery during development drilling in the Maui B Field of a deeper oil pool that reportedly will produce up to 30,000 barrels of oil a day when fully commissioned during the next month.
NZOG said this oil may have been generated from the west of the field, where a number of potentially very large structures have been identified by NZOG, within its new licence.

It said preparations were under way to acquire further data, including 600 km of new seismic data to better delineate these structures and enable a drilling location to be defined, by the end of this financial year.
Acquisition of the licence represented a shift of exploration emphasis for NZOG, by targeting offshore acreage with high potential prospects.
